argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Reductio ad absurdum of stage theory via compositional semantics
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: High - formal semantic analyses are spelled out step-by-step

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: Moderate - considers three defenses but rejects them
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High - each argument directly targets stage theory's semantic claims
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Contested - relies on natural language syntax being endurantist/worm-friendly, which stage theorists may deny

distinctions_drawn: Endurantism vs. Perdurantism vs. Stage theory
Quantificational vs. Operator analysis of tense
explicit_definitions_given: Stage theory: ordinary names denote instantaneous temporal stages
Quantificational analysis: times are explicit quantified arguments
Operator analysis: tense is a propositional operator shifting evaluation time

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Considers ellipsis, adverbial modification, and supervaluationism; rejects all as ad hoc or self-defeating

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Formal semantic analysis, syntactic tree diagrams, logical notation, thought experiments
named_thought_experiments: Kant was born and died in Königsberg

philosophical_orientation.grounding: Analytic philosophy, formal semantics, metaphysics of persistence
philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Anti-revisionary metaphysics; natural language semantics is a constraint on ontology

structural_organization.structure_type: Problem-solution with systematic elimination of defenses

summary_of_core_decisions: Stage theory fails because it cannot compositionally handle multiple tensed verbs with a single referring expression; all defenses either smuggle in worm theory or rely on unmotivated syntactic machinery.
